theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 132: Put the verbs into the correct form: -ing or the infinitive with to … .

Bài 132: Chia động từ đúng dạng: -ing hoặc to + nguyên mẫu.

Exercise 133: Put the verbs into the correct form: -ing or the infinitive with to … (Cyclist abandons 24 hr ride).

Bài 133: Chia động từ đúng dạng: -ing hoặc to + nguyên mẫu (Tay đua xe đạp bỏ cuộc đua 24 giờ).

Exercise 134: Complete the conversations with suitable verbs in the correct form: -ing or the infinitive with to … .

Bài 134: Hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại với động từ phù hợp ở dạng đúng: -ing hoặc to + nguyên mẫu.

Exercise 135: Complete the sentences using -ing or the infinitive with to … .

Bài 135: Hoàn thành câu dùng -ing hoặc to + nguyên mẫu.

Exercise 136: Complete the conversations with the correct form of the verbs and any other words you need.

Bài 136: Hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại với dạng đúng của động từ và các từ cần thiết khác.

Exercise 137: Complete the sentences with your own ideas. Use -ing or the infinitive with to … .

Bài 137: Hoàn thành câu theo ý của bạn. Dùng -ing hoặc to + nguyên mẫu.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 53–58 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 53–58 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: I don’t get on with the new boss, so I’ve asked ___ to another branch of the company.
mcq.full: I don’t get on with the new boss, so I’ve asked to be transferred to another branch of the company.
mcq.vi: Tôi không hợp với sếp mới, nên tôi đã xin được chuyển sang chi nhánh khác.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + to be + V3 (bị động).
mcq.key: I don’t get on with the new boss, so I’ve asked ___ to another branch of the company.|to be transferred

mcq.question: Please stop ___ me when I’m explaining something to you.
mcq.full: Please stop interrupting me when I’m explaining something to you.
mcq.vi: Làm ơn đừng ngắt lời tôi khi tôi đang giải thích.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: stop + V-ing (thôi làm).
mcq.key: Please stop ___ me when I’m explaining something to you.|interrupting

mcq.question: He admits ___ the house, but he says he didn’t take anything.
mcq.full: He admits entering the house, but he says he didn’t take anything.
mcq.vi: Hắn thừa nhận đã vào nhà, nhưng nói không lấy gì.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: admit + V-ing.
mcq.key: He admits ___ the house, but he says he didn’t take anything.|entering

mcq.question: What a beautiful house! Can you imagine ___ there?
mcq.full: What a beautiful house! Can you imagine living there?
mcq.vi: Ngôi nhà đẹp quá! Bạn có tưởng tượng được việc sống ở đó không?
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: imagine + V-ing.
mcq.key: What a beautiful house! Can you imagine ___ there?|living

mcq.question: I’ve forgotten ___ my briefcase with me. I’ll have to go back for it.
mcq.full: I’ve forgotten to bring my briefcase with me. I’ll have to go back for it.
mcq.vi: Tôi quên mang cặp theo. Tôi phải quay lại lấy.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: forget to do = quên làm.
mcq.key: I’ve forgotten ___ my briefcase with me. I’ll have to go back for it.|to bring

mcq.question: I don’t mind ___ late if it will help at all.
mcq.full: I don’t mind working late if it will help at all.
mcq.vi: Tôi không ngại làm muộn nếu điều đó có ích.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: mind + V-ing.
mcq.key: I don’t mind ___ late if it will help at all.|working

mcq.question: We had hoped ___ in our new house by now, but the builders are still working on it.
mcq.full: We had hoped to be living in our new house by now, but the builders are still working on it.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi đã mong giờ này đang sống ở nhà mới, nhưng thợ vẫn đang làm.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: hope + to be + V-ing.
mcq.key: We had hoped ___ in our new house by now, but the builders are still working on it.|to be living

mcq.question: You’ll just have to find a job. I simply can’t afford ___ you any longer.
mcq.full: You’ll just have to find a job. I simply can’t afford to support you any longer.
mcq.vi: Bạn phải đi tìm việc thôi. Tôi không đủ khả năng nuôi bạn nữa.
mcq.expl:
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= not remember to do), hope, afford; to be -ing (continuous infinitive), to be done (passive infinitive).
+ -ing: stop, admit, imagine, mind; + to …: ask, forget (= quên làm), hope, afford; to be -ing (nguyên mẫu tiếp diễn), to be done (nguyên mẫu bị động).
Điểm ngữ pháp: afford + to V.
mcq.key: You’ll just have to find a job. I simply can’t afford ___ you any longer.|to support

mcq.question: For the second time, Andrew Spicer has decided ___ the attempt.
mcq.full: For the second time, Andrew Spicer has decided to give up the attempt.
mcq.vi: Lần thứ hai, Andrew Spicer quyết định từ bỏ nỗ lực.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: decide + to V.
mcq.key: For the second time, Andrew Spicer has decided ___ the attempt.|to give up

mcq.question: Andrew Spicer has decided to give up the attempt ___ his bike non-stop for twenty-four hours.
mcq.full: Andrew Spicer has decided to give up the attempt to ride his bike non-stop for twenty-four hours.
mcq.vi: Andrew Spicer quyết định từ bỏ nỗ lực đạp xe không nghỉ suốt hai mươi bốn giờ.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: attempt (danh từ) + to V.
mcq.key: Andrew Spicer has decided to give up the attempt ___ his bike non-stop for twenty-four hours.|to ride

mcq.question: Dangerous weather conditions had caused him to postpone ___ for several hours.
mcq.full: Dangerous weather conditions had caused him to postpone setting off for several hours.
mcq.vi: Thời tiết nguy hiểm khiến anh phải hoãn xuất phát vài giờ.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: postpone + V-ing.
mcq.key: Dangerous weather conditions had caused him to postpone ___ for several hours.|setting off

mcq.question: His first attempt had also ended in failure, when he appeared ___ control of his bicycle.
mcq.full: His first attempt had also ended in failure, when he appeared to lose control of his bicycle.
mcq.vi: Lần thử đầu cũng thất bại, khi anh có vẻ mất kiểm soát xe.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: appear + to V.
mcq.key: His first attempt had also ended in failure, when he appeared ___ control of his bicycle.|to lose

mcq.question: He attempted to avoid ___ a small child and crashed into a wall.
mcq.full: He attempted to avoid hitting a small child and crashed into a wall.
mcq.vi: Anh cố tránh đâm vào một em nhỏ và đâm vào tường.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: avoid + V-ing.
mcq.key: He attempted to avoid ___ a small child and crashed into a wall.|hitting

mcq.question: He says that he has not yet decided whether ___ one more time.
mcq.full: He says that he has not yet decided whether to try one more time.
mcq.vi: Anh nói vẫn chưa quyết định có thử thêm lần nữa không.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: whether + to V.
mcq.key: He says that he has not yet decided whether ___ one more time.|to try

mcq.question: … but denies ___ interest in the project.
mcq.full: … but denies having lost interest in the project.
mcq.vi: … nhưng phủ nhận đã mất hứng thú với dự án.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: deny + V-ing / having + V3.
mcq.key: … but denies ___ interest in the project.|having lost

mcq.question: ‘I’ve promised ___ money for the local hospital,’ he explained.
mcq.full: ‘I’ve promised to raise money for the local hospital,’ he explained.
mcq.vi: ‘Tôi đã hứa quyên góp tiền cho bệnh viện địa phương,’ anh giải thích.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: promise + to V.
mcq.key: ‘I’ve promised ___ money for the local hospital,’ he explained.|to raise

mcq.question: ‘I shall do what I can if I manage ___ the time.’
mcq.full: ‘I shall do what I can if I manage to find the time.’
mcq.vi: ‘Tôi sẽ làm những gì có thể nếu thu xếp được thời gian.’
mcq.expl:
+ to …: decide, attempt (noun) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
+ to …: decide, attempt (danh từ) to, appear, promise, manage, whether to; + -ing: postpone, avoid, deny (deny having done).
Điểm ngữ pháp: manage + to V.
mcq.key: ‘I shall do what I can if I manage ___ the time.’|to find

mcq.question: I’m hoping ___ my brother at his university if I can.
mcq.full: I’m hoping to visit my brother at his university if I can.
mcq.vi: Tôi đang mong đến thăm anh trai ở trường đại học nếu có thể.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hope + to V.
mcq.key: I’m hoping ___ my brother at his university if I can.|to visit

mcq.question: No, I was planning ___ him then, but he texted me.
mcq.full: No, I was planning to see him then, but he texted me.
mcq.vi: Không, lúc đó tôi định gặp anh ấy, nhưng anh ấy nhắn tin.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: plan + to V.
mcq.key: No, I was planning ___ him then, but he texted me.|to see

mcq.question: He texted me and suggested ___ the visit for a week.
mcq.full: He texted me and suggested postponing the visit for a week.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy nhắn tin và đề nghị hoãn chuyến thăm một tuần.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: suggest + V-ing.
mcq.key: He texted me and suggested ___ the visit for a week.|postponing

mcq.question: … because he hadn’t finished ___ his thesis.
mcq.full: … because he hadn’t finished writing his thesis.
mcq.vi: … vì anh ấy chưa viết xong luận văn.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: finish + V-ing.
mcq.key: … because he hadn’t finished ___ his thesis.|writing

mcq.question: One of our main customers has said he’ll consider ___ to another supplier if we don’t improve our delivery times.
mcq.full: One of our main customers has said he’ll consider going to another supplier if we don’t improve our delivery times.
mcq.vi: Một khách hàng lớn nói sẽ cân nhắc chuyển sang nhà cung cấp khác nếu chúng ta không cải thiện thời gian giao hàng.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: consider + V-ing.
mcq.key: One of our main customers has said he’ll consider ___ to another supplier if we don’t improve our delivery times.|going

mcq.question: Have we been failing ___ on time?
mcq.full: Have we been failing to deliver on time?
mcq.vi: Chúng ta không giao hàng đúng hạn à?
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: fail + to V.
mcq.key: Have we been failing ___ on time?|to deliver

mcq.question: Apparently someone forgot ___ one order last month.
mcq.full: Apparently someone forgot to send one order last month.
mcq.vi: Hình như tháng trước có người quên gửi một đơn hàng.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: forget to do = quên làm.
mcq.key: Apparently someone forgot ___ one order last month.|to send

mcq.question: So I agreed ___ them myself this time.
mcq.full: So I agreed to post them myself this time.
mcq.vi: Nên lần này tôi đồng ý tự gửi chúng.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: agree + to V.
mcq.key: So I agreed ___ them myself this time.|to post

mcq.question: We can’t risk ___ such an important customer.
mcq.full: We can’t risk losing such an important customer.
mcq.vi: Chúng ta không thể liều mất một khách hàng quan trọng như thế.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: risk + V-ing.
mcq.key: We can’t risk ___ such an important customer.|losing

mcq.question: Why does he keep ___ you?
mcq.full: Why does he keep texting you?
mcq.vi: Sao anh ta cứ nhắn tin cho bạn mãi thế?
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: keep + V-ing.
mcq.key: Why does he keep ___ you?|texting

mcq.question: He’s offered ___ me fix my car this weekend.
mcq.full: He’s offered to help me fix my car this weekend.
mcq.vi: Anh ta đề nghị giúp tôi sửa xe cuối tuần này.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: offer + to V.
mcq.key: He’s offered ___ me fix my car this weekend.|to help

mcq.question: He’s offered to help me fix my car this weekend if I agree ___ them.
mcq.full: He’s offered to help me fix my car this weekend if I agree to join them.
mcq.vi: Anh ta đề nghị giúp tôi sửa xe cuối tuần này nếu tôi đồng ý tham gia đội.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: agree + to V.
mcq.key: He’s offered to help me fix my car this weekend if I agree ___ them.|to join

mcq.question: You can’t avoid ___ to him forever.
mcq.full: You can’t avoid replying to him forever.
mcq.vi: Bạn không thể tránh trả lời anh ta mãi được.
mcq.expl:
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
+ to …: hope, plan, fail, forget (to do), agree, offer; + -ing: suggest, finish, consider, risk, keep, avoid.
Điểm ngữ pháp: avoid + V-ing.
mcq.key: You can’t avoid ___ to him forever.|replying

mcq.question: (Terry: Can you help me?) Terry wanted Chris ___.
mcq.full: (Terry: Can you help me?) Terry wanted Chris to help him.
mcq.vi: (Terry: Cậu giúp tớ được không?) Terry muốn Chris giúp anh ấy.
mcq.expl:
want / order / ask somebody to do; regret doing; make somebody do; try to do (attempt); need doing (= need to be done); help somebody (to) do.
want / order / ask ai đó to do; regret doing; make ai đó do; try to do (cố gắng); need doing (= cần được làm); help ai đó (to) do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: want + O + to V.
mcq.key: (Terry: Can you help me?) Terry wanted Chris ___.|to help him

mcq.question: (Coach to Hugo: You’re late again! Do fifty press-ups!) The coach ordered ___.
mcq.full: (Coach to Hugo: You’re late again! Do fifty press-ups!) The coach ordered Hugo to do fifty press-ups.
mcq.vi: (HLV với Hugo: Lại muộn! Hít đất năm mươi cái!) HLV ra lệnh Hugo hít đất năm mươi cái.
mcq.expl:
want / order / ask somebody to do; regret doing; make somebody do; try to do (attempt); need doing (= need to be done); help somebody (to) do.
want / order / ask ai đó to do; regret doing; make ai đó do; try to do (cố gắng); need doing (= cần được làm); help ai đó (to) do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: order + O + to V.
mcq.key: (Coach to Hugo: You’re late again! Do fifty press-ups!) The coach ordered ___.|Hugo to do fifty press-ups

mcq.question: (Steve: Will you sign the petition?) Steve asked ___.
mcq.a: the woman to sign the petition
mcq.full: (Steve: Will you sign the petition?) Steve asked the woman to sign the petition.
mcq.vi: (Steve: Chị ký vào bản kiến nghị nhé?) Steve đề nghị người phụ nữ ký vào bản kiến nghị.
mcq.expl:
want / order / ask somebody to do; regret doing; make somebody do; try to do (attempt); need doing (= need to be done); help somebody (to) do.
want / order / ask ai đó to do; regret doing; make ai đó do; try to do (cố gắng); need doing (= cần được làm); help ai đó (to) do.
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + O + to V.
